name: Hisakaki Kosame
source:
Likes: Her twin sister
Dislikes: To be snooped inadvertently

The younger of the Hisakaki twins and [url=/c3882]You's[/url] classmate. Kosame likes to tease her friends but at the same time, keeps a lot of secrets. She has a calm and mysterious personality and often randomly takes sides in arguments. Like her [url=/c3932]sister[/url], she is also a shrine maiden. Despite her habit of constantly teasing her elder sister, Kosame is actually weak to being teased herself.
